title: Intake has a repeat-reads detector over the call census
goal: backlog.py intake runs a detector that reads the committed call rows and files a draft story naming a command-head class or tool group that one or more sessions repeat more than N times in a week (N in the notes), with the existing section-sized command to use instead when one exists; it has a count budget like the drift detector, files nothing below its threshold, and files each finding once by fingerprint.
notes: Call rows (ST-rpdfgu3t) hold no paths, so file groups are named only if ST-rpdfgu3t adds a closed file-group class; with the fleet retired fewer sessions run per week, so the threshold counts repeats, not agents.
